periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Inward diagonal orientation at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with an elongation factor favoring the diagonal primary axis over the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering towards the muzzle, shifting the visual mass below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior edge across the scapular region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately 35-40% of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation on the cranial vault, approximately 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous semi-circular curvature at the superior boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellow-brown discoloration of the ventral fur on the lower abdomen and inner thighs compared to the white thoracic pelage.
